تغتالون (form VIII)
# تَغْتَالُونَ (taḡtālūna) /taɣ.taː.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
# تُغْتَالُونَ (tuḡtālūna) /tuɣ.taː.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
